description: Get a cross-chain risk overview across all 5 chains (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Polygon, Optimism) in a single call. Returns protocol-level risk stats for each chain: total positions, danger/warning/critical counts. Use when asked: 'Which chain has the most at-risk positions?', 'Give me a risk dashboard across all chains', 'Compare Aave risk levels across networks'.
name: get_cross_chain_risk_summary
